info.title: PackageMedic
info.description: A read-only dependency doctor for SDK-style .NET projects.

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Analyze existing project.assets.json files without restoring

options.name: --format
options.description:
Output format (default: text)
--fail-on none|warning|error Exit 1 at or above this severity (default: warning)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Exit codes:
0  Analysis completed below the configured --fail-on threshold
1  At least one diagnostic reached the configured --fail-on threshold
2  Usage, restore, configuration, or analysis error
